crossRefs.note: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
He said, “Bring them here to me.”
Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish…
“There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

parallels.note: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

translations.web: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
translations.bsb: “Go and see how many loaves you have,” He told them. And after checking, they said, “Five—and two fish.”
translations.kjv: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
translations.asv: And he saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
